conflicts.permit: Advertisers and advertising networks use some of the information collected by the Application, including, but not limited to, the unique identification ID of your mobile device.
conflicts.prohibit: No. Third parties cannot see or have access to information obtained by the Application.
conflicts.situation: When third-party advertisers or ad networks access information collected by the Application, such as unique device IDs.
conflicts.reason: One section explicitly states third parties cannot see or access information obtained by the Application, while the next section states third-party advertisers use this information without reconciling the statements.
